bio: Situated in a small garden in the historic centre, this modern bistro has a light, airy feel thanks to its large windows and its outdoor tables perfect for alfresco dining in summer. The menu features contemporary-style, personalised meat and fish dishes which are full of flavour, while at lunchtime, the lighter “Pranzetto” menu is a good option. The restaurant also offers an excellent selection of cocktails for an evening aperitif, plus an impressive choice of digestifs to enjoy after your dinner....
